explication: Invoice Ninja is a Laravel invoicing and business-management application for hosted and self-hosted use. The main workflow is an authenticated business user creating an invoice, having it processed by invoice services, and returning it through the API; related capabilities include client-portal access, payment collection, expenses, quotes, purchase orders, reporting, and electronic invoicing. The README documents the request/controller/service/response pattern, but the supplied tree omits several of those implementation layers, so only documented or sampled connections are drawn.
